social_circle.name: Diane Marquette

demographics.occupation: Part-time dental office front desk and insurance paperwork staff
demographics.education: Some college or vocational office/medical billing training

background.how_they_met: They met as young adults in central North Carolina before marrying in John's late twenties.
background.why_close: They have built a long marriage, raised two children, share household finances, and balance each other's temperaments: John is structured and Diane is more spontaneous.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, practical sentences, often about schedules, errands, bills, meals, and family check-ins. She is warmer and more emotionally direct than John, but not overly dramatic.

shared_activities: Cooking together a couple nights a week
Church two or three Sundays a month
Walks when John's knees feel decent
Sunday family supper
Managing bills, appointments, and household plans
recent_text_topics: Coordinating supper, grocery needs, and whether John will be home closer to 3:30 or 5:00 after route changes.
Checking on John's online business class nights and protecting time for coursework.
Updates about John's mother, including medication chart reminders and whether Linda has handled appointments.
Household budget notes after Diane's brake repair and ordinary spending categories like groceries, insurance, and copays.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says John is married to Diane, she works part time at a dental office, and they have been married close to thirty years. Q11 says Diane handles many bills and appointments while John handles yard, vehicles, repairs, and cooking. Q45 says John copes by talking with Diane.

social_circle.name: Linda Marquette

demographics.education: High school diploma with some community college coursework

background.how_they_met: Linda is John's younger sister; they grew up together in Angier with both parents.
background.why_close: They share family history and jointly care for their aging mother, with Linda handling many appointments and John handling errands, repairs, and medication systems.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short, direct updates, often with practical details and occasional pointed opinions. She may use brief confirmations like 'Got it' or 'I'll call Mama after lunch.'

shared_activities: Coordinating their mother's care
Sharing family news
Checking in weekly
Occasional political conversations that they back away from before damage is done
recent_text_topics: Their mother's arthritis, memory slips, refill dates, and whether the pill organizer is set up correctly.
Scheduling which weekend John will come to Angier for groceries, pharmacy runs, or small repairs.
Brief family updates about Emily, Mark, Clara, and Diane.
Careful political back-and-forth that they usually shut down before it gets heated.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says John's mother lives near his sister Linda and that he and Linda check in weekly. Q35 says Linda handles most appointments while John handles errands and repairs. Q44 describes John and Linda making a medicine chart at their mother's table. Q30 says Linda is more conservative and disagreements can get heated.

social_circle.name: Emily Marquette

background.how_they_met: Emily is John's first child; her birth was a major turning point in how he measured success and family responsibility.
background.why_close: John respects Emily's thoughtfulness, teacher perspective, and care for her daughter Clara. Emily is the family member he finds easiest to talk with about sensitive social issues.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete sentences but often quickly between school and parenting tasks. She sends photos of Clara, school updates, and practical requests without much fuss.

shared_activities: Sunday family suppers when schedules align
Occasional help with Clara pickup
Grandparent-grandchild visits
Conversations about schools, history, families, and fairness
recent_text_topics: Clara asking about postcards, watercolor, and when Granddaddy can paint little houses with her.
Emily's hard teaching year and stress from school responsibilities.
Coordinating family supper and occasional childcare pickup when Emily is in a bind.
School history discussions, including Emily's belief that schools should teach history more honestly.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Emily as John's 28-year-old daughter, an elementary school teacher near Fuquay-Varina, married with daughter Clara. Q19 says Emily is now managing school routines as a teacher and mother. Q30 says Emily is thoughtful and easiest for John to talk with about race and schooling. Q46 says Emily has had a hard teaching year.

social_circle.name: Mark Marquette

demographics.education: High school diploma plus HVAC technical training

background.how_they_met: Mark is John's younger adult child, raised by John and Diane in Benson.
background.why_close: They connect through practical work, vehicles, tools, and a shared comfort with hands-on problem solving. Mark still comes by to eat, do laundry, and talk trucks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually and briefly, with practical questions, photos of equipment or trucks, and occasional dry humor. He is less likely to write long emotional messages.

shared_activities: Talking trucks when Mark visits
Occasional overnight stays in the guest room
Sunday suppers when schedules line up
Practical father-son advice about work, tools, and vehicles
recent_text_topics: Whether Mark is coming by to do laundry, eat, or crash in the guest room after a late job.
HVAC service schedule uncertainty and work being slow or busy.
Truck maintenance, tools, and whether a repair is worth doing himself.
Occasional disagreements or jokes about 'politics in everything,' especially when family discussions get broader.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Mark is 24, works in HVAC service out of Raleigh, is single, and comes by every couple of weeks to do laundry, eat, and talk trucks. Q13 says Mark sometimes crashes in the guest room. Q30 says Mark is more skeptical about race and politics. Q46 says Mark acts easygoing but work uncertainty gets to him.

social_circle.name: Ray Hinson

background.how_they_met: Ray and John met through courier work and became friends beyond the job.
background.why_close: They share route work, practical habits, and monthly bowling. John identifies Ray as one of the people he would call directly for support depending on the issue.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short, casual bursts, often with route gripes, bowling reminders, weather comments, and practical check-ins. He is more likely to send a quick joke than a long paragraph.

shared_activities: Monthly senior bowling league
Courier work conversations that continue outside work
Checking in after stressful days or doctor visits
Occasional sports and local road talk
recent_text_topics: Bowling schedule reminders and joking about whose knee is worse this month.
Workday route changes, traffic, and weather, discussed as friends rather than through company channels.
John's hopes for a supervisory logistics role and the new dispatch software.
Panthers, Durham Bulls updates, and whether anyone is taking an extra Saturday route.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Ray as someone who works with John and bowls with him once a month, in the context of important non-family friends. Q49 says John would call Diane, then Linda or Ray depending on the issue. Q77 says John is closest to Ray and Darnell at work, supporting that Ray is a genuine personal friend rather than only a professional contact.
